Binary Search Trees

One rule (smaller keys left, bigger keys right, all the way down) gives you three tools: a sorted inorder walk you can pause, a binary-search-style walk from the root, and the middle-of-a-range trick for building. Validate, kth smallest, iterators, insert and delete, successor, recovering a swapped pair, building a balanced tree and closest values are all one of those three.
